title: Smooth pullbacks and Cartan homotopy formula for affine homotopies of C^∞ maps (smooth case of Simon 2.25)
statement: Conventions: ℝ^N = Euclid N and Hᵈ = μHE[d]. 𝒟^d(U) = TestFormOn U d (smooth d-forms with compact support in U) and 𝒟_d(U) = GeometricCurrentOn U d; ∂X = X.boundary; X − Y is pointwise on test forms. |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α is the Euclidean coefficient norm of a covector and ‖·‖ is the operator norm. M_W(X) = X.massOn W and M(X) = X.mass = M_univ(X). An IMRep R = (M, θ, ξ) (contract structure IMRep U d) has μ_R = θ·Hᵈ⌞M = R.measure and R.action(γ) = ∫_M θ ξ(γ) dHᵈ for any d-form γ; X is IM if some IMRep represents it. X vanishes off E if X(ω) = 0 whenever tsupport ω is disjoint from E. For a map Φ and a form ω, Φ^#ω(x) := ω(Φ(x)) ∘ DΦ(x) (Lean (ω (Φ x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ Φ x)). (a) Let N, N', m ∈ ℕ, Φ : ℝ^N → ℝ^{N'} C^∞ (ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞)) and α a C^∞ m-form on ℝ^{N'} (IsSmoothForm α). Then Φ^#α is C^∞. (b) Let P, k ∈ ℕ, let F, G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ and let ω be a C^∞ (k+1)-form on ℝ^P. For an (m+1)-form β (m ∈ ℕ) define the m-form K β by K β(x)(v_1, …, v_m) := ∫_0^1 β(F(x) + t(G(x) − F(x)))(G(x) − F(x), A(t,x)v_1, …, A(t,x)v_m) dt, with A(t,x) := DF(x) + t(DG(x) − DF(x)). In Lean, K β x = ∫ t in 0..1, ((β (F x + t • (G x - F x))).curryLeft (G x - F x)).compContinuousLinearMap (fderiv ℝ F x + t • (fderiv ℝ G x - fderiv ℝ F x)). Then K ω is C^∞, and for every x: G^#ω(x) − F^#ω(x) = d(K ω)(x) + K(dω)(x). Here d = exteriorDerivative = Mathlib extDeriv, so K(dω) uses the (k+2)-form dω.
